data.title: Jackson Robotics Team Earns National Honors
data.description: JACKSON – Four Jackson Township High School students were honored by local officials after placing among the nation’s top teams in a Technology Student Association robotics competition.   Joseph “Joey” Orecchio, Deven Stab, Raymond Panariello and Aditi Gupta received a proclamation during a recent Township Council meeting recognizing their advancement to the national semifinals.
